changelog:
Initial release of feishu-agent-add

- Introduces a conversational skill for adding Feishu agents to OpenClaw without manual config editing.
- Guides users through necessary input collection (agent name, purpose, app id/secret) with minimal questions.
- Presents a summary preview before executing the setup script.
- Runs a script to generate and update agent configuration, then summarizes results and next steps.
- Supports both guided flows and ready-to-run terminal commands for advanced users.
